function.name: SysFreeString
function.header_comment:
/******************************************************************************
 *		SysFreeString	[OLEAUT32.6]
 *
 * Free a BSTR.
 *
 * PARAMS
 *  str [I] BSTR to free.
 *
 * RETURNS
 *  Nothing.
 *
 * NOTES
 *  See BSTR.
 *  str may be NULL, in which case this function does nothing.
 */
